title: The Sound of a Black Hole

scenes.text: Black holes are silent. Space carries no air for sound.
But the gas around them is not silent.
It ripples in pressure waves you could hear if your ears were light years wide.
One of them hums fifty-seven octaves below middle C.
It has been humming the same note for two billion years.
